title: World Instant Leaf Decay
description: Hate waiting for leaves to slowly disappear after cutting a tree? Hate the lag from other leaf decay mods? This mod makes it so that leaves instantly disappear, no particles, no scattered drops, the drops all focus to one point.
body:
# World Instant Leaf Decay

![World Instant Leaf Decay cover image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/instant-leaf-decay/main/.modcompiler-art/description-image.webp)

Tired of waiting for leaves to slowly decay after cutting down a tree? This mod makes leaves decay instantly!

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/5bHD7CJGsmo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features

- ✅ **Instant Decay** - All leaves disappear immediately when you break a log
- ✅ **No Particles** - Massive performance boost by removing leaf particle effects
- ✅ **Stacked Drops** - All items (saplings, apples, sticks) stack and drop at the center
- ✅ **Vanilla Loot Rates** - Respects proper drop chances for each tree type
- ✅ **All Tree Types** - Works with oak, birch, spruce, jungle, acacia, and dark oak
- ✅ **Smart Detection** - Only decays natural leaves, not player-placed ones

## How It Works

Break a log from any tree.
All connected leaves instantly disappear (no particles!).
Drops are calculated using vanilla loot tables.
Items spawn stacked at the center of the leaf cluster.

## Drop Rates

The mod respects vanilla Minecraft drop rates:.
- **Oak/Dark Oak**: 5% sapling, 0.5% apple, 2% sticks
- **Jungle**: 2.5% sapling, 2% sticks
- **Spruce/Birch/Acacia**: 5% sapling, 2% sticks
